scope: Literal tracked source/report review only, not rerun or actual execution attestation; historical report lacks raw-input/source-version binding. No timing/correctness/absence or new algorithm claim.
observations: Constructor filters nonliftable candidates while scanning an arithmetic progression, returns upon reaching size, and does not enforce constant gaps or compare the resulting constraint to the intended full falling-factorial polynomial.
Tracked Method C has two factor-base variables X2,X3 in F3(xR,X2,X3); pair-sum control tests R-fb[k]=fb[i]+fb[j], using three factor-base points.
Sage set_random_seed(42) does not seed secrets.randbelow, which selects secret and query scalar coefficients; the two arms choose independent query targets.
Method C increments the relation counter on coordinate membership without a signed point identity check in that branch. This is a source-level validation gap, not a demonstrated false Semaev witness.
The report itself flags filtered-natural-order degeneration, but d>1 is not required for a genuine arithmetic progression: any nonzero constant step including1 is valid if no candidates are skipped.
